CI remediation for Gerrit change 1376 — pushed patch set 3 (78e1dd8816, same Change-Id If7bd2a6). Fixes for the PS2 Verified failures:

1) lint (lint + type-check job): comment-hygiene gate failed — src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py:1 module docstring tripped [dated-incident] on '2026-08-04' + 'observed'. Fixed by dropping the rot-prone date and citing the durable grouped-hex ticket id: '(bug 9305, operator-ratified 2026-08-04)' -> '(bug 9305-b42c, operator-ratified)'. ruff check/format, mypy, config-check, verify-gate-parity all green.

2) pytest (ubuntu/macos py3.11-3.13): the ~341 reconciler BackendEnvError failures were STALE — they came from an older tree (the error strings 'missing Jira Cloud configuration' / HTTP-Basic-auth cloud message do not exist anywhere in the PS2 tree). PS2's actual tree passes them locally, incl. the exact CI-named tests (test_applier, test_managed_refs unlink-after-compaction, test_mcp readonly dry-run, test_code_review_artifact). Root cause: origin/main had advanced 4 commits past PS2's base (a41705); rebased PS2 onto current origin/main so the fresh CI merge-preview reflects current main.

Local status on the rebased PS3 tree: make lint / typecheck / config-check GREEN; git-lock behavioral suite tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py 9/9 pass; reconciler apply + previously-CI-failing suites 215/215 pass. (Pre-existing host-env failures ignored: ddgs ImportError in test_web_tool_gating, plus test_ref_lock/reconcile_bridge push-retry which also fail on pristine origin/main.) Change intent unchanged (local git call sites absorb lock contention). Awaiting fresh LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submit; ticket stays in_progress.
